source.title: I Tested Every Single GTA
source.timing_note: Timings were read off a line-broken public transcript, not word timestamps, so every start/end is +/-2 s. build.sh re-derives exact word timings from the source file and snaps every clip to the nearest sentence edge before rendering.

style.note: GTA cover-grid red. One accent, white on black, nothing else.

candidates.hook: A glitch saved Grand Theft Auto
candidates.title: How a bug saved GTA and led to GTA 6
candidates.caption: GTA was nearly cancelled in 1995. Then a bug made the police ram you off the road, and that accident became the sandbox every GTA is built on. 30 years later, GTA 6. Clip: Mrwhosetheboss. #GTA6 #GTA #RockstarGames #gamedev #retrogaming
candidates.start_line: The driving was awful. The game crashed constantly, and worst of all, it was just boring
candidates.end_line: this complete accident set off a chain reaction that 30 years later gave us the most hyped game in history, GTA 6
candidates.why: Opens on a complete, self-contained setup and resolves on the line the whole launch day is about. No sponsor, no music bed, no gameplay reaction. Strongest clip in the set.

candidates.title: The GTA bug that created the wanted system
candidates.caption: GTA's cops were coded to pull you over. A route-finding bug made them ram you instead, and that mistake became the wanted system and the whole sandbox idea. Clip: Mrwhosetheboss. #GTA #gamedev #Rockstar #GTA6 #gaminghistory
candidates.start_line: See, the cops were coded to pull you over when they caught up with you
candidates.end_line: the real fun was giving people a giant sandbox and allowing them to just muck around inside and see what happened
candidates.why: Bug, turn, consequence. Explains why every GTA since feels the way it does, which is exactly the argument the source video is making.

candidates.title: How GTA 3 fit a whole city in 32MB
candidates.caption: The PS2 had 32MB of memory. Liberty City in 3D needed about 100. Rockstar loaded a bubble around the player instead of the city, and 3D open worlds were never the same. Clip: Mrwhosetheboss. #GTA3 #gamedev #PS2 #Rockstar #leveldesign
candidates.start_line: To give you an idea, this extremely powerful PS2 console had 32 MGB of memory
candidates.end_line: The console is only ever holding a couple of city blocks at a time
candidates.why: Numbers a stranger can hold in their head, then the trick that closed the gap. Reads as engineering, not nostalgia, so it travels outside the GTA audience.

candidates.title: GTA 6's trailer broke YouTube anyway
candidates.caption: 90 videos of GTA 6 leaked in 2022. A year later a 90-second trailer still became the most watched trailer in YouTube history, nearly doubling Avengers Endgame. Clip: Mrwhosetheboss. #GTA6 #Rockstar #gaming
candidates.start_line: Someone, this guy hacked Rockstar's servers and leaked 90 videos of their game in 2022
candidates.end_line: it became the most watched trailer in YouTube history, almost doubling the view count of Avengers Endgame
candidates.why: Two hard numbers and a reversal in 18 seconds. Shortest and most postable of the set, and it is squarely about the game launching today.

candidates.title: What GTA 6's wanted stars actually mean
candidates.caption: GTA 6's wanted stars are not a countdown. Solid means they can see you, flashing means they lost you, hollow means they are still guessing, red means you slipped the zone. Clip: Mrwhosetheboss. #GTA6 #gamingtips #Rockstar #openworld
candidates.start_line: And the now up to six wanted stars tell you more than just how dead the police want you
candidates.end_line: red means you've technically escaped, but you're still inside the search zone
candidates.why: The most useful detail in the video for someone who has not played yet: four star states, each with its own meaning, then the thesis that the police only know what a witness saw. Ends on a clean idea.
